text:
Maya: Heads-up: eviction telemetry spend jumped last billing cycle. thinking we should sample evict events instead of emitting everything.

Kevin: Sampling makes sense. key constraint: samples must be repeatable per prefix so trend lines and deduping still work.

Srini: Right. simplest: deterministic hash on prefix_id + sample band. e.g.
```
BAND = 's1' # s0=100%, s1=10%, s2=1%
if hash(prefix_id) % 100 < band_to_pct[BAND]:
    emit("evict.event", {"prefix": prefix_id, "band": BAND})
```
This keeps selection stable across hosts.

Jess: We should never sample away known heavy hitters. plan: maintain a small top-k sketch (count-min) that promotes top prefixes into s0 (always emit). that prevents missing regressions.

Ava: Ops perspective: detection latency for eviction storms is critical. naive global sampling delays detection. we should allow a short-term forcing rule: if eviction rate for tenant spikes > X, escalate to full telemetry for that tenant for Y minutes.

Kevin: Good idea. Implementation: deterministic sampler + a recent-rate check that bypasses sampling. sampler remains consistent but bypass tag included.

Maya: Important ops note: add a sample_band tag (not raw pct) so dashboards can scale counts by band multiplier. prefer enum bands s0/s1/s2 to limit cardinality.

Srini: Also avoid adding many new labels. include only: prefix, tenant_id (coarse), band, bypass=true/false. keep tenant coarse grained (hash shard) to reduce cardinality.

Jess: Proposed rollout:
- Phase A: 10% deterministic sampling (s1) + emit parity full-events to blobstore for 48h to validate.
- Phase B: enable top-k exemption and bypass rules for high-rate tenants.
- Phase C: adaptive bands per-tenant based on historical variance.
Each phase has a canary on 5% of hosts first.

Ava: For alerts run A/B: compare current alert triggers vs sampled stream for 72h. add runbook entry: if missed-detection rate > 2% escalate.

Maya: Who takes which action?
Kevin: I'll push a prototype sampler and a config flag (telemetry.eviction.sampling) + sample_band tag.
Srini: I'll sketch the band enum mapping and shard-level tenant tag to control cardinality.
Jess: I'll write the count-min top-k sketch plan and an eval that replays historical full events through the sampler to estimate false negatives.
Ava: Ops will prepare the alert A/B and rollback checklist.

evict-bot: [alert] tenant-572 eviction surge (200r/s). parity logs confirm event seen; sampled stream would have missed unless bypass triggered.

Maya: Good catch. parity check must stay until phase B validated. If replay shows <0.5% missed critical events we can relax to 5% global sample.

Kevin: Implementation note: keep sampling code path extremely cheap. compute hash once, check against thresholds, attach band tag, emit. avoid extra allocations.

Srini: Also add metric: sampled_rate_by_band so we can monitor effective sampling and adjust config.

Maya: OK. I'll schedule a 1hr rollout window next Wednesday. Kevin, ping when PR is ready and we'll run the canary.

Jess: one more: instrument replay test to surface which prefixes would flip state under different band thresholds so we can tune exemption k.

Maya: Thanks team. action items summary: Kevin prototype + PR, Srini band enum + cardinality plan, Jess sketch top-k + replay eval, Ava prepare alert A/B and runbook.
